entities.summary: Tetsuya Komuro (b. 1958-11-27, Setagaya) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Setagaya and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
